					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SPR_applied_public_procurement

				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {

					}
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SPR_v2_programme_psoe }
			}
		}
		else = {

				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SPR_v2_programme_psoe }
			}
		}

			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SPR_applied_service_oath }

		}

COLDWAR_SPR_complete_cooperative_credit = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_SPR_campaign = yes
			COLDWAR_SPR_franco_has_left_office = yes
			custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = COLDWAR_SPR_v2_government_pce_iu_tt COLDWAR_SPR_government_pce_iu = yes }
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = COLDWAR_SPR_cooperative_credit_funds_tt
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = 1.3 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			92 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by = ROOT offices < 50 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SPR_applied_cooperative_credit }
			OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SPR_applied_worker_democracy }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1.3 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		92 = {
			add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
			add_building_construction = { type = offices level = 1 instant_build = yes }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SPR_applied_cooperative_credit
		COLDWAR_SPR_sync_programmes = yes
	}
}
